target_name: Oslo-cast principals in Epstein's black book
summary: No Oslo-channel principal appears in Epstein's main address book across redacted, fuller, FBI, Kabasshouse, and separate 36-page contact-book renderings.
detail: A read-only WP2 sweep searched 46 required spellings and institutional strings independently across five book renderings/artifacts (230 term-copy cells), plus full-identity phrases, the FBI release corpus, Kabasshouse address-book context queries, and the Kabasshouse entity layer. Zero identity-confirmed Oslo-cast entries were found. There were no genuine +47 numbers, Norway fields, or whole-word Oslo fields. Adjudicated collisions included Janet Larsen; unrelated Ron and Joel entries; a Paris concierge labeled Ms. Peres; a first-name-only Marianna/Marianne in a sensitive California massage list; Dr. Hirshfield in a medical section; an OCR-only Uri in a company line; and an OCR FAFO token inside Craig Tafoya's Fort Lauderdale contact entry. The 2003 birthday book was searched separately and was also null for Oslo cast, but it is a different artifact and is not counted as black-book evidence. Mirrors were deduplicated as one underlying source. The negative result does not fire pre-committed rule 3; it contributes only to the possible all-null retirement rule across WP1-WP5.
